p: rest for thee: Meaning that she would provide her with a husband, with whom she might live peacefully.
man: Boaz, nor yet any other.
heart was merry: That is, he had refreshed himself among his servants.
shewed more kindness in the latter: You showed yourself repeatedly to be more virtuous.
will perform unto thee the part: If he will take you to as his wife because of his relation by marriage, according to God's law, De 25:5.
Who art thou: Believing by her returning home that he had not taken her as his wife, she was astonished.
